title: Rashee Rice: Jail time was "learning experience" and "reality check"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rashee Rice: Jail time was "learning experience" and "reality check"
sources.description: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice had an unexpected 30-day offseason jail stint, due to a positive THC test while on probation for felony charges arising from a 2024 street-racing incident.
